sources.title: SDXL Lightning - 1 Step | Stable Diffusion XL Checkpoint | Civitai
sources.snippet: SDXL-Lightning is a lightning-fast text-to-image generation model. It can generate high-quality 1024px images in a few steps. For more information, please refer to our research paper: SDXL-Lightning: Progressive Adversarial Diffusion Distillation. We open-source the model as part of the research.

sources.title: SDXL-Lightning: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: fast-lightning-sdxl by fal-ai is a commercial API service wrapping fast SDXL inference rather than an open-source model. Use this if you want managed inference without deploying locally; use SDXL-Lightning if you need self-hosted deployment, full control over inference parameters, or cost predictability without per-request API pricing.
